name.zh: 汉语语言生项目（2027年春季学期）

languageRequirements.minimum: The spring guide lists Chinese-language classes at levels 101/102, 103/104, 201, 202, 301 and 302; it does not publish a minimum entry HSK score. Ask QDU about the appropriate class and any individual language requirements.

faculty.en: Qingdao University, College of International Education; International Students Office
faculty.zh: 青岛大学国际教育学院；留学生事务大厅

overview.en: A non-degree Chinese-language programme for the spring semester of 2027. The advertised semester is March to July 2027, with the dates still to be confirmed.
overview.zh: 2027年春季学期非学历汉语语言生项目。公布学习期为2027年3月至7月，日期待定。

qualification.en: Chinese-language study; the guide does not advertise a degree award.
qualification.zh: 汉语语言学习，简章未列为学历学位项目。

languagePolicy.en: The programme teaches Chinese-language skills, including comprehensive Chinese, speaking, listening, reading and writing at the listed levels. The guide does not promise English-medium classroom explanations or publish an entry HSK threshold.
languagePolicy.zh: 课程学习汉语综合、口语、听力、阅读、写作等技能，按公布的级别设置；简章未承诺以英语讲解，未公布入学HSK最低分。

curriculumHighlights.en: Classes are compulsory Monday to Friday, 08:00–12:00 in the morning. Regular attendance is required to maintain student visa status; failure to attend regularly leads to termination of enrolment.
curriculumHighlights.zh: 周一至周五上午8:00—12:00为必修课程；须正常出勤以维持学生签证身份，经常缺课将终止学籍。

curriculumHighlights.en: The table lists levels 101/102, 103/104, 201, 202, 301 and 302. Offerings vary by level and include comprehensive Chinese, speaking, listening, reading, culture, news listening, grammar and writing. Class arrangements may vary.
curriculumHighlights.zh: 课程表列101/102、103/104、201、202、301、302级，按级别安排汉语综合、口语、听力、阅读、文化、新闻听力、语法和写作；具体课程安排可能调整。

eligibility.en: Non-Chinese citizens holding a valid foreign passport, aged 18–50.
eligibility.zh: 持有效外国护照的非中国籍公民，年龄18—50岁。

eligibility.en: Applicants must be healthy and meet China’s health-examination standards for foreign students, have no criminal record, and be willing to comply with Chinese laws, regulations and university rules.
eligibility.zh: 身体健康，符合国家“外国来华留学生健康检查标准”；无违法犯罪记录，愿意遵守中国法律、法规及学校纪律。

eligibility.en: Supply the required school enrolment or diploma evidence and transcript. The English materials list accepts current-enrolment certification or a diploma, while the Chinese list asks for the highest diploma and transcript; check with QDU which document applies to your circumstances.
eligibility.zh: 须提交学籍或学历及成绩材料。英文清单列在读证明或毕业证及成绩单，中文清单列最高学历毕业证及成绩单；请按个人情况向学校确认应交证明。

applicationMaterials.en: Complete the online application form and financial guarantee information; the Chinese list expressly includes the financial guarantee.
applicationMaterials.zh: 在线填写申请表及经济担保证明，中文材料清单明确列有经济担保证明。

applicationMaterials.en: Upload a clear scan of the passport front page.
applicationMaterials.zh: 扫描上传清晰护照首页复印件。

applicationMaterials.en: Upload the highest diploma and transcript; the English guide additionally names current-enrolment certification as an alternative to a diploma.
applicationMaterials.zh: 扫描上传最高学历毕业证及成绩单；英文清单另外列在读证明可作为毕业证的替代材料。

applicationMaterials.en: Provide a physical-examination certificate and a non-criminal-record certificate.
applicationMaterials.zh: 提供体检证明及无犯罪证明。

applicationMaterials.en: After the application passes pre-evaluation, follow the emailed instructions to pay the CNY400 application fee and upload proof of payment. The application fee is non-refundable.
applicationMaterials.zh: 报名信息预审通过后，按系统邮件缴纳400元申请费并上传缴费凭证；申请费不退还。

applicationMaterials.en: Scholarship applicants must also follow the instructions for their scholarship category and complete the online application after the college accepts the materials.
applicationMaterials.zh: 奖学金申请人另须参照对应奖学金须知，在材料通过学院审核后完成在线申请。

notes.en: Apply before 11 December 2026, as worded by QDU; no opening date or cutoff time is published. The spring semester is advertised as March–July 2027, to be confirmed; registration is expected in March and the Admission Notice gives the exact dates. Tuition is CNY7,000 per semester; the separate CNY400 application fee is non-refundable and payable after pre-evaluation, followed by an uploaded payment receipt. Insurance is CNY300 per semester. The guide refers applicants to the Fees page for dormitory prices and does not guarantee accommodation. The English and Chinese academic-document lists differ: current-enrolment certification or a diploma plus transcript in English, highest diploma plus transcript in Chinese; financial-guarantee information is expressly listed in Chinese. Ask QDU which evidence fits your case. Compulsory classes run Monday to Friday 08:00–12:00; poor attendance can terminate enrolment. Class arrangements may vary. Accepted applicants receive the Admission Notice and JW202 or DQ documents by email; consult the relevant Chinese embassy or consulate about the appropriate X1/X2 visa. Register at the International Students Office within the designated period. Scholarship applications have separate instructions and do not imply an award. Contact oip@qdu.edu.cn, +86-532-85953863; International Students Office, Minxing Building, 308 Ningxia Road, Qingdao.
notes.zh: 须在2026年12月11日之前申请，学校未公布起报日或当天截止时点。春季学期公布为2027年3—7月，日期待定；预计3月报到，具体以录取通知书为准。学费7000元/学期，另付400元不退申请费；预审通过后按邮件缴费并上传凭证。保险300元/学期；宿舍费由简章指向学校费用网页，本简章未列价格或保证房源。中英文学历材料清单有差异：英文列在读证明或毕业证及成绩单，中文列最高学历毕业证及成绩单，且明确列经济担保证明；请向学校确认个人适用要求。周一至周五上午8—12点必修，持续缺课会终止学籍；课程安排可能调整。录取者通过邮件收到录取通知书和JW202或DQ，X1/X2签证办理请咨询中国使领馆；在指定时间到留学生事务大厅报到。奖学金另按相应须知申请，不代表保证获奖。咨询oip@qdu.edu.cn，+86-532-85953863；地址青岛市宁夏路308号敏行楼留学生事务大厅。

name.zh: 汉语进修生项目（2027年春季）

languageRequirements.minimum: Chinese-language classes are offered at beginner, intermediate and advanced levels. The spring 2027 guide does not publish an entry HSK minimum; choose the programme matching your study plan and confirm the appropriate level with QUST.

faculty.en: International College, Qingdao University of Science and Technology
faculty.zh: 青岛科技大学国际学院

overview.en: A non-degree Chinese-language programme starting in March 2027, with a one-semester or one-year study option. The official study period is March–June 2027 or March–December 2027.
overview.zh: 2027年3月入学的非学历汉语进修项目，可选择1学期或2学期，官方学习时间为2027年3—6月或3—12月。

qualification.en: Long-term Chinese-language study; no academic degree is advertised for this route.
qualification.zh: 长期汉语进修，本路线未列学历学位授予。

languagePolicy.en: Chinese-language study is available at beginner, intermediate and advanced levels. The guide does not state an entry HSK score or promise English-medium classroom explanations.
languagePolicy.zh: 提供初级、中级、高级汉语学习。简章未规定入学HSK分数，也未承诺英语讲解。

curriculumHighlights.en: The official course description lists 20 required class hours per week, with intensive reading, oral Chinese, extensive reading and listening. The senior class includes news listening, newspaper reading and Chinese writing.
curriculumHighlights.zh: 官方课程说明列每周20课时必修，包括精读、口语、泛读和听力；高级班包括新闻听力、报刊阅读及汉语写作。

curriculumHighlights.en: The general course description lists cultural electives such as calligraphy, tai chi, Chinese painting, folk music, culture, literature, film and philosophy, plus intermediate and advanced HSK courses; confirm current availability with QUST.
curriculumHighlights.zh: 一般课程说明列书法、太极、国画、民族音乐、中国文化、文学、电影、哲学等选修及中高级HSK课程，具体当期开设情况请向学校确认。

eligibility.en: Non-Chinese citizens with a valid foreign passport, aged 18–60, with junior-high-school education or equivalent.
eligibility.zh: 持有效外国护照的非中国籍公民，年龄18—60岁，具初中及以上或同等学历。

eligibility.en: Applicants must be healthy, have no criminal record, and comply with Chinese laws, regulations and university rules.
eligibility.zh: 身体健康，无违法犯罪记录，遵守中国法律、法规及学校纪律。

eligibility.en: Students transferring from another Chinese university must obtain a T visa locally and provide the original completion certificate and original examination results from the previous university.
eligibility.zh: 从中国其他高校转校者须在当地办理T签证，并提供原学校结业证明原件及考试成绩原件。

applicationMaterials.en: Provide a clear copy of the passport front page.
applicationMaterials.zh: 提供清晰护照首页复印件。

applicationMaterials.en: Provide the highest diploma or degree certificate. The Chinese guide requires the original and a Chinese or English translation when it is not in English; the English guide requires a Chinese or English certificate.
applicationMaterials.zh: 提供最高学历毕业证；非英语材料按中文简章同时提供原件及汉语或英语翻译件，英文简章要求证书为中文或英文。

applicationMaterials.en: Transfer students must additionally provide the original completion certificate and original examination results, and obtain the locally required T visa.
applicationMaterials.zh: 转校生另须原学校结业证明及考试成绩原件，并办理当地T签证。

applicationMaterials.en: Register and complete the official online application truthfully, selecting one semester or two semesters according to your study plan. Pay the CNY400 non-refundable application fee after passing pre-evaluation.
applicationMaterials.zh: 在官方系统注册并如实填写申请，按学习计划选择1学期或2学期；初审通过后缴纳400元不退申请费。

notes.en: The official spring 2027 guide states an application deadline of 30 November 2026, with study from March to June 2027 or March to December 2027. Select one semester or two semesters in the application system; no numeric month conversion or full-programme tuition total is supplied here. No opening date or cutoff time is published. Tuition is CNY7,000 per semester and payable for the semesters/academic year shown on JW202 or DQ. The separate CNY400 application fee is payable after pre-evaluation and non-refundable regardless of the review result. Tuition is non-refundable unless the reason is attributable to the university. The linked fee schedule lists term-time dormitory prices by room category and number of occupants, with separate holiday prices; a CNY500 deposit is returned if the room and contents are undamaged, electricity is extra, semester dormitory charges are non-refundable for early checkout, and stays under two months use short-term rates. Insurance is CNY800 per year or CNY400 per half year and is bought online; the fee page states insurance is required for stays over six months. Residence-permit fees are CNY400 per half year and the initial physical examination is about CNY200–600. Agreement-based group/institution fees may differ. After approval, QUST emails the Admission Letter and JW202 or DQ. Transfers from other Chinese universities require a local T visa plus the original completion certificate and original examination results. Contact aoic@qust.edu.cn, +86-532-88959006/88956873; Admission Office, Nanyuan Building1, 99 Songling Road, Qingdao. The official Chinese and English pages currently both name spring2027 and the 2026 deadline, but their displayed publication dates are 2024-11-29 and 2024-12-02. These dates are retained as a source anomaly; no year was rolled forward by the catalogue.
notes.zh: 官方2027春季简章明确截止2026年11月30日，学习时间为2027年3—6月或3—12月，申请时选择1学期或2学期；这里不换算月数，也不自行列全程学费合计。未公布起报日或当天截止时点。学费7000元/学期，按JW202或DQ标注的学期或学年支付；另付400元申请费，初审通过后缴纳，无论审核结果如何均不退还。学费非校方原因不退。链接费用页按房型及入住人数列学期内宿舍费，假期费用另计；住宿押金500元，无损坏退房时退还，电费自理。宿舍按学期收费，中途退房不退，不足两月按短期标准。保险800元/年或400元/半年，网上自行购买；费用页列在华超过六个月须购买。居留许可400元/半年，首次体检约200—600元。协议单位、团体按协议收费。录取后学校邮件发送录取通知书和JW202或DQ。从国内其他高校转校者须当地T签证及原学校结业证明、考试成绩原件。咨询aoic@qust.edu.cn，+86-532-88959006/88956873；青岛市松岭路99号南苑1号楼招生办公室。中英文官网当前正文均明确2027春季及2026截止日，但页面显示发布时间分别为2024-11-29、2024-12-02；此处保留该来源异常，未由平台滚动推演年份。
